plan: Deep-copy the recipe at the start of adapt so inputs are never mutated and print_original can return authored_text byte-for-byte.
Scale all quantities (top-level ingredients and each component's ingredients) by the Fraction ratio target_yield / recipe yield.

Resolve each excluded ingredient through a substitution chain: select the catalog choice with the minimal (priority, catalog index) key, apply the result's name/quantity_factor/unit/preparation, queue wording_changes as text edits, apply equipment additions/removals to a working equipment list, and accumulate any yield_factor.
Insert additional ingredients (pre-scaled) into the same ingredient list right after the current one so they pass through the identical exclusion/substitution pipeline, giving chained adaptation.

Detect cycles with a per-chain seen-name set (reason: 'substitution cycle involving NAME'); report 'no substitution for NAME' when no catalog entry matches; record every applied choice ID in order and emit a warning whenever a substitution introduces another excluded ingredient.

Never early-return on failure: collect all reasons in a set, then check the final sorted equipment list against available_equipment so equipment reasons and substitution reasons can co-occur; return sorted, deduplicated reasons with recipe=None when nonempty.
If any substitution carried a yield_factor, rescale all quantities by its inverse (with a warning) so the adapted recipe sits exactly at the target yield.
Apply accumulated wording edits to all instruction strings (including component instructions), set yield to target_yield and equipment to the sorted list, sort warnings, and return the result dict.

Include an executable __main__ acceptance suite covering: 3→5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment rewrite, reintroduced-exclusion warning, multiple simultaneous impossibility reasons, byte-exact original print plus input immutability, cycle detection, and deterministic priority with catalog-order tie-break.
mechanisms: copy-on-entry immutability: deepcopy of the recipe; catalog extras are deep-copied before insertion; request never touched
rational scaling: single Fraction scale factor applied uniformly, plus per-substitution quantity_factor multiplication
deterministic choice selection: min over (priority, catalog index) among entries whose 'for' matches the ingredient name
per-ingredient substitution chain with seen-set cycle detection
in-place work-list insertion of additional ingredients so they undergo the same exclusion/substitution processing
accumulated (old,new) wording edits applied to every instruction string at the end
working equipment list with add/remove deltas, sorted, then membership-checked against available_equipment
exhaustive reason collection in a set (no early return), sorted on output
yield_factor compensation: final inverse rescale of all quantities plus a warning, keeping the recipe at the target yield
iteration guard bounding pathological additional-ingredient recursion, reported as a substitution cycle
